title: Mobile Learning Platform & Interactive Courses & Hackathons for Aiken & Python Development

ms.promise:
- Initial working mobile app that allows users:
 + Login with an existing account or signup for a new account
 + See the list of available courses
 + Join a course and start learning with multiple lesson types: video, lecture, code snippets, quizzes
 + Finish the lessons to make progress
- First mobile-friendly Aiken course, that covers following contents:
 + Crash course on EUTxO
 + Aiken programming language
 + Smart Contract development with Aiken programming language
ms.criteria:
- Working mobile app with all the features mentioned in the output above. The app should be published on Apple AppStore and Google Play Store
- Mobile friendly Aiken course is available in the app for all users, with the content mentioned above
- Acquire 100+ early learners for the course and 10+ reviews/feedbacks collected from the app and the AppStore
